svg.text: ROCm 7.14 · Single-card RAM16 tier, four agents at 131k target
What / how to read: Qualification run for the 16 GiB shared-memory tier with four agents on one card. It is the key smooth-operation milestone; read error count, turn
completion, TTFT by depth and memory pressure together.
PP unavailable: completion-credited counter bursts are diagnostic only, not sustained prefill throughput.
